billing.question: How do I update my billing information?
billing.answer: To update your billing information, go to your account settings and look for the 'Billing' section. From there, you can update your payment details.

support.question: How can I contact customer support?
support.answer: You can contact our customer support through the 'Contact Us' page. We're available via phone, email, or live chat.

profile.question: How do I update my profile information?
profile.answer: To update your profile information, log into your account and go to the 'Profile' section to make changes to your details.

history.question: How do I find my purchase history?
history.answer: You can find your purchase history in your account dashboard under the 'Order History' section.

warranty.question: What is the warranty on bikes?
warranty.answer: We offer a 2-year warranty on frames and a 1-year warranty on other parts. For more details, please check our warranty policy.

assembly.question: Do you offer bike assembly services?
assembly.answer: Yes, we offer free bike assembly for all bikes purchased through our store. Our experts will ensure everything is set up perfectly.

returns.question: Can I return a bike if I don't like it?
returns.answer: Yes, you can return a bike within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, provided it's in unused condition. Please refer to our return policy for more details.

financing.question: Do you offer financing options?
financing.answer: Yes, we offer financing options through our partners. You can choose to pay in installments over several months. Please check our financing page for more information.
